ABOUT THE SAMPLES

Different kinds of trip, one day-by-day atlas.

1 · Switch journeys

Use the selector above the day list to try mixed transport, rail and bus, driving, and bicycle stories.

2 · Every leg matters

Each calendar day can stay still, move once, make a loop, or combine several ordered transport modes.

3 · Keep the context

A day close-up leaves the rest of its journey quietly visible while bringing the selected route to the front.

4 · Photos follow the map

Open any photograph to move through the trip and see its day and location alongside it.

Sample data: these journeys demonstrate the viewer and are not records of the family trip.
